title: どんぐりころころ (Donguri Koro Koro — Rolling Acorn)
description: An acorn rolls into a pond and meets a friendly loach (どじょう) who invites it to play. But the acorn misses the mountains and cries, leaving the loach puzzled. Two charming verses with simple, vivid vocabulary. Published 1921; considered one of Japan's three greatest children's songs. Both composer 梁田貞 (d.1959) and lyricist 青木存義 (d.1935) had copyrights expire before Japan's 2018 extension — fully public domain.
